visual_inspection.method: Rendered Playwright contact sheets from verified local file URLs and inspected the PNG sheets with Codex image viewing.
inspection_notes: Service/company assets are mostly text-rich panels and should not be treated as flexible text-overlay backgrounds.
Industry assets are route-relevant but contain baked-in labels, dashboards, metrics, or mock UI that must be presented as illustrative panels, not client proof or live software screenshots.
Email extras are strongest for clinic or automation campaign contexts and include near-duplicates that should not be reused repeatedly on one page.
